description: Train AGAINST the iid sycophancy probe (original-model probing: frozen Qwen3.5-4B scores the generated text each step, tinker backend). Hold out the 2 CoT monitors + the ood deception probe, measured on the held-out eval set every eval_every steps. The cross-method degradation question: does training against the sycophancy probe degrade the CoT monitors and/or the ood probe? max_tokens=4096 matches the probe's training distribution (it was fit on FINISHED rollouts) and lets the policy actually conclude its <think> block + emit a parseable answer; Qwen3.5-4B finishes ~44-51% at this budget (the practical ceiling — higher just pays for the long tail). Per-forward cost scales with sequence length, so this is slower per step than a truncated 1024 budget but avoids scoring the probe / rewarding the task on truncated, unparseable rollouts.
